text:
mira: quick note from onboarding: our sample apps and CLI disagree on auth TTL and scope merging. caused confusion for a new customer.

sam: can you summarize the behaviour?

mira: short repro:
```bash
# env provides user key and default org
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-user-zzz
export REDWOOD_ORG=org-default
# start sample app (goes to org-default)
./examples/sample-app &
# infra rotates key and updates docs to sk-user-new
# env updated in deployment but app keeps using old token until restart
```

olga: two separate problems: 1) rotation auto-refresh not enabled in samples, 2) precedence when both REDWOOD_PROJECT and a session exist is inconsistent. Some clients prefer session org over REDWOOD_PROJECT.

mira: impact: silent misrouting/billing; new users assume env vars win.

doc-bot: created RW-7744 "sample-auth-ttl-and-precedence" (assigned: sam)

sam: proposals:
- Canonical precedence: CLI flag > explicit client param > REDWOOD_* env > session cache > keychain. Make this doc the single source.
- Samples: add small reload hook (SIGHUP) and show client.reload_credentials().
- CLI: add `--auth-watch` to refresh on env change and a warning when config set changes project but session.org differs.

olga: tests: add mid-run rotation e2e and a unit for precedence merge logic. Add telemetry keys: `auth.rotate_miss` and `auth.precedence_conflict`.

ryan: small UX ask: show a one-line warning in CLI when using cached session with mismatched project: "Session org (org-old) != target project org (org-new). Run `redwood auth refresh` to update."

mira: i'll attach a tiny reproducer to RW-7744 and update the sample-app README. docs team can add the precedence table to quickstart.

sam: i'll own a 1-day spike then a PR for samples + CLI warning. tagging @eng-devex @platform. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
